name: Curtis conjecture
statement: At p=2, the positive-dimensional spherical classes in H_*(Q_0 S^0;F_2) are exactly those arising from Hopf-invariant-one and Kervaire-invariant-one elements.
status_2026: open; substantial partial vanishing results
credibility_or_evidence: Compatible with all computed stems and filtration restrictions; strongest classical spherical-class prediction.
source: Curtis; Wellington; later work of Hung, Zare, Eccles

name: Eccles conjecture
statement: For connected X, a positive-dimensional spherical class in H_*QX is either stably spherical or comes from a stable map detected by a primary operation in its mapping cone.
status_2026: open in general; verified in selected loop spaces
credibility_or_evidence: Generalizes the Hopf/Kervaire detection philosophy.
source: Eccles; expositions and partial verifications by Zare

name: Lannes-Zarati algebraic spherical-class conjecture
statement: The s-th Lannes-Zarati homomorphism vanishes in every positive stem for s>2.
status_2026: open; proved in families and ranges
credibility_or_evidence: Algebraic shadow of the Curtis conjecture; known nonzero cases occur in filtrations 1 and 2.

name: Freyd generating hypothesis
statement: A map of finite spectra inducing zero on all stable homotopy groups is null.
status_2026: open globally; false in several localized/analogous categories
credibility_or_evidence: Would make pi_* faithful on finite spectra; resisted all known approaches.

name: New Doomsday conjecture
statement: Every nontrivial Sq^0-family in the mod-2 Adams E_2-page has only finitely many members that survive to E_infinity.
status_2026: open in general; established for major low-filtration families including the e-family
credibility_or_evidence: Doomsday differentials on h_j^3 and the 2026 e-family theorem support it.

name: Ravenel odd-primary EHP birth conjecture (Conj. 1.5.20)
statement: Predicts the sphere of origin, EHP differentials, and Hopf invariants for divided alpha-family classes.
status_2026: not correct verbatim; Ravenel records an explicit p=3 exception; viable only after refinement
credibility_or_evidence: Organizes extensive EHP data but requires exceptions.

name: Ravenel EHP differential conjecture for eta_j (Conj. 1.5.26)
statement: For k=(2s+1)2^{j-2}, s>0, the predicted EHP differential d_{2^j-2}(nu)=eta_j occurs.
status_2026: open in stated generality
credibility_or_evidence: Fits Mahowald-style EHP patterns.

name: Kervaire EHP-pattern conjecture (Ravenel Conj. 1.5.27)
statement: Predicts EHP behavior and spheres of origin for Kervaire classes theta_j.
status_2026: existence portion settled/refuted by dimension (theta_1...theta_6 only, with theta_6 currently a preprint theorem); differential pattern remains partly open
credibility_or_evidence: Low cases and classical EHP calculations.

name: Mahowald invariant of Kervaire classes
statement: M(theta_j) contains theta_{j+1} whenever both classes exist.
status_2026: meaningful only for existing consecutive classes; partially verified
credibility_or_evidence: Root-invariant and EHP calculations in low dimensions.

name: Chromatic Mahowald/root-invariant conjecture
statement: When consecutive Greek-letter classes alpha_j^(n) and alpha_j^(n+1) exist, the higher-height class lies in the Mahowald invariant of the lower-height class.
status_2026: open; many low-height examples and motivic/root-invariant calculations
credibility_or_evidence: Captures observed redshift of root invariants.

name: Ravenel beta_1 exponent conjecture at p>=7 (Conj. 7.6.2)
statement: beta_1^{p^2-p} is nonzero, beta_1^{p^2-p+1}=0, with a specified higher Toda bracket producing beta_1^{(2p-1)(p-1)/2}.
status_2026: open for p>=7; p=5 analogue computed with beta_1^17 nonzero and beta_1^18 killed
credibility_or_evidence: Fits the complete p=5 calculation and chromatic heuristics.

name: Chromatic splitting conjecture - weak form
statement: For finite p-complete X, L_{n-1}X -> L_{n-1}L_{K(n)}X is split monic.
status_2026: open in general; known at n=1 and several height-2 odd-prime cases
credibility_or_evidence: Survives after stronger decompositional forms fail.

name: Chromatic splitting conjecture - strongest classical decomposition
statement: A precise wedge decomposition of lower chromatic localizations of the K(n)-local sphere.
status_2026: false at n=p=2; refined variants remain open
credibility_or_evidence: Beaudry produced a contradiction to the strongest Hovey formulation.

name: Redshift conjecture
statement: Algebraic K-theory of a suitably height-n ring spectrum exhibits height n+1 phenomena, together with corresponding descent properties.
status_2026: major upper-bound and many positive cases proved; full lower-bound/descent package open
credibility_or_evidence: Hahn-Wilson, Clausen-Mathew-Naumann-Noel, and subsequent work prove broad forms and bounds.

name: Moore conjecture on homotopy exponents
statement: A finite simply connected CW complex has a finite p-primary homotopy exponent iff its rational homotopy is finite-dimensional (rationally elliptic).
status_2026: open in general; many elliptic families and special classes proved
credibility_or_evidence: Includes odd-sphere exponent theorems as central evidence.
source: J. C. Moore; Selick; modern exponent literature

name: Unique smooth sphere conjecture
statement: Among n>4, the only dimensions with a unique smooth structure on S^n are 5,6,12,56,61.
status_2026: open; verified through the current low-stem range
credibility_or_evidence: All computed Kervaire-Milnor groups support the list.

name: Very exotic sphere conjecture
statement: Very exotic spheres exist in every dimension >4 except 5,6,11,12,27,43,56,61.
status_2026: open; new 192-periodic constructions prove infinite congruence classes
credibility_or_evidence: Stable coker-J detections and recent eta-torsion families.

name: Smooth 4-dimensional Poincare conjecture
statement: Every smooth homotopy 4-sphere is diffeomorphic to S^4.
status_2026: open
credibility_or_evidence: Separate from stable-stem methods and high-dimensional surgery.

name: Hopkins-Mahowald height-two family predictions
statement: Predicts specific 192-periodic height-two families and orders in congruence classes modulo 192.
status_2026: many predictions confirmed; catalog not known to be exhaustive
credibility_or_evidence: Carrick-Davies confirm a large collection, including tmf-invisible families.

name: Singer algebraic transfer conjecture
statement: Singer conjectured that the mod-2 algebraic transfer is injective (monic) in every rank and degree.
status_2026: original global conjecture is challenged/refuted by current preprints claiming counterexamples in ranks 5 and 6; low-rank and degreewise injectivity results remain valid
credibility_or_evidence: The counterexample claims are recent preprints and should be independently audited; the unqualified global conjecture should no longer be presented as a credible open prediction.
source: Singer; Sum arXiv:2408.06669; Phuc arXiv:2509.09455v11; rank-4 positive results

name: Asymptotic stable-stem growth sharpness scenario
statement: A strong form of telescope failure would make the exp(Theta((log n)^3)) upper-scale for cumulative Adams data essentially sharp for stable stems.
status_2026: conditional prediction, not a standard named conjecture
credibility_or_evidence: Burklund-Senger upper bounds and chromatic heuristics.

name: Telescope conjecture
statement: T(n)-localization and K(n)-localization agree on spectra of chromatic height n.
status_2026: historical conjecture; preprint theorem gives counterexamples at every prime and every height >=2; true at heights 0 and 1
credibility_or_evidence: No longer listed as a credible open conjecture at height >=2.

name: Kervaire invariant one in dimensions beyond 126
statement: Historical prediction that further theta_j might exist.
status_2026: refuted for j>=7 by Hill-Hopkins-Ravenel; theta_6 existence is a current preprint theorem
credibility_or_evidence: Retained only as historical status, not a credible conjecture.

name: Mahowald uncertainty principle
statement: Heuristic tradeoff: classes easy to detect chromatically tend to be hard to construct geometrically, and vice versa.
status_2026: heuristic, not a formal conjecture
credibility_or_evidence: Useful organizing principle, but not a precise falsifiable statement.

name: Odd-primary spherical-class conjectures
statement: At an odd prime, positive-dimensional spherical classes in the homology of Q_0S^0 should be restricted to the corresponding low-filtration Hopf/J and exceptional chromatic detections, with no large unexplained families.
status_2026: no single universally accepted formulation; several precise variants and partial vanishing theorems
credibility_or_evidence: Odd-primary Dyer-Lashof structure and Adams-filtration constraints parallel the 2-primary Curtis philosophy, but the correct final formulation is less settled.
source: Eccles, Wellington, Zare, and odd-primary spherical-class literature

name: Smith-Toda complex existence pattern
statement: For a prime p and height n, one seeks finite type-n complexes V(n) with BP-homology BP_*/(p,v_1,...,v_n), subject to prime-size constraints; broad existence/nonexistence patterns are expected but not known uniformly.
status_2026: case-by-case; V(3) does not exist at p=5 and V(2) is not a ring spectrum there; higher cases remain incomplete
credibility_or_evidence: The p=5 beta_1-power computation gives sharp nonexistence information; periodicity theory supplies existence after weakening the precise Smith-Toda form.
source: Ravenel 2026, Theorem 7.6.1; Smith-Toda and Hopkins-Smith literature

name: Sharp unstable homotopy growth conjectures
statement: For a fixed sphere, the p-primary ranks and total torsion should exhibit explicit chromatic growth laws substantially sharper than the current exp(O((log n)^3)) upper bounds.
status_2026: open; several hyperbolicity and lower-bound results, but no sharp general asymptotic
credibility_or_evidence: Stable chromatic families and rational/elliptic-hyperbolic dichotomies suggest structured growth, while current finite tables are too short to identify a law.
source: Burklund-Senger; Boyde; rational homotopy hyperbolicity literature
